summary.text: Benjamin William Barker (born 23 April 1991) is a British professional racing driver currently competing in the FIA World Endurance Championship. A Porsche stalwart for over a decade, he is an Australian Formula 3 champion, a Porsche Carrera Cup GB runner-up, a four-time Bathurst 12 Hour class winner and a Dubai 24 Hour overall winner. Despite limited success in the FIA World Endurance Championship, Barker is considered one of the strongest GTE Am drivers, having broken the lap record for the category at the 2018 24 Hours of Le Mans.

summary.text: Benjamin Jon Rhodes (born February 21, 1997) is an American professional stock car racing driver. He competes full-time in the NASCAR Craftsman Truck Series, driving the No. 99 Ford F-150 for ThorSport Racing. He is the 2021 and 2023 Truck Series champion. Before moving up to the Truck Series, Rhodes competed full-time in what is now the ARCA Menards Series East, where he drove for Turner Scott Motorsports and won the 2014 series championship. He also has previously competed part-time in the NASCAR Cup Series, the NASCAR Xfinity Series, and what is now the ARCA Menards Series.

Fionn McLaughlin (Magherafelt, Irlanda del Norte; 29 de octubre de 2007) es un piloto de automovilismo irlandés. Ha sido miembro del Equipo Júnior de Red Bull desde 2024. Fue campeón de la F4 Británica en 2025, su primer año en monoplazas. En 2026 será piloto de Hitech en el Campeonato de Fórmula 3 de la FIA.

Gabriele Minì (Palermo, Sicilia, 20 de marzo de 2005) es un piloto de automovilismo italiano. Desde 2023 forma parte de la Academia Alpine. Fue campeón del Campeonato de Italia de Fórmula 4 en 2020 y subcampeón de la Fórmula Regional Europea en 2022. En 2023 disputó el Campeonato de Fórmula 3 de la FIA con el equipo Hitech Pulse-Eight, y en 2024 resultó subcampeón de la categoría con Prema Racing. En 2025 compitió con el mismo equipo en el Campeonato de Fórmula 2 de la FIA. En 2026 lo hace como piloto de MP Motorsport.

Tom Karel Lily Van Rompuy (born 8 September 1987) is a Belgian amateur racing driver currently competing in the FIA World Endurance Championship, driving for Akkodis ASP Team in the LMGT3 class.

Van Rompuy's career highlights include taking third place in the LMP2 Pro-Am subclass of the 2023 24 Hours of Le Mans, scoring the first ever LMGT3 pole in the WEC in Qatar, and winning the 6 Hours of Fuji.
